description:
There are a whole lot of basic life things that would be outstandingly helpful in getting through day to day life that we just aren’t fucking’ taught.

Or the lessons are presented as soft skills and wisdom that doesn’t make a practical difference in our lives.

This series is an attempt to help remedy that educational deficiency, so we still get a go at learning the shit we SHOULD’VE been taught a long fuckin time ago 🔥

So starting with the basics; your physiology has a profound effect on your emotional experience. Deal with the easy stuff before panicking about the tricky stuff.

#Growth #mentalhealthawareness #mindset #positivity #procrastination
